findings.entity: Man seated at counter (master wide shot)
findings.invariant_violated: depth ordering / impossible body geometry vs counter
findings.description: After the cut at 00:36.458 the man faces the camera with his torso, hands, mug and plate on the far (worker) side of the counter top, yet his jeans-clad legs are rendered in front of the counter's front apron on the stool/customer side. A solid counter cannot sit between his torso and his legs. This also contradicts 00:24-00:27, where in the same master angle he sat on a customer-side stool with his back to camera; the reverse at 00:45 likewise places him on the worker side of a counter segment. Persists through 00:44.9.

findings.entity: Waitress crossing from stool side to worker side of counter
findings.description: At ~01:51.5 the waitress stands on the customer side among the stools leaning on the counter; between ~01:52.0 and 01:52.5 she moves straight through the counter: her torso is above/behind the counter top while one leg is still rendered in front of the counter apron, and by 01:53 she is fully in the worker aisle with her back to camera. There is no gap or flap in that stretch of counter and the camera never cuts, so she passes through solid geometry.

findings.entity: Seated man and waitress, left/right ordering across the cut
findings.description: In the master at 01:21-01:26.7 the waitress sits on the far side of the man (deeper in the room, toward the back wall and pass-through), i.e. on his left as both face the counter. In the reverse close two-shot from behind the counter at 01:26.792 she sits on his right (camera-left), with the refrigerated case (located near the front of the diner in the 00:45 reverse) also camera-left, which puts her on the front side. Their ordering is mirrored relative to the established layout.
